post.description: Creates a new AI agent with the specified configuration

description.description: **Description**: A brief description of the agent.

ownerID.description: **Owner ID**: The unique identifier of the agent's owner.

theme.description: **Theme**: The visual theme of the agent, e.g., 'blue-light' or 'custom-blue-dark'.

keywords.description: Keywords to focus on in the transcription.
Keywords or phrases to focus on in the transcription.

model.description: The Google Cloud Speech model to use.

transcriber.description: **Transcriber**: The configuration options for the transcriber provider used by the agent.

highAudioQuality.description: Generate highest quality audio possible, must have pro plan or higher on elevenlabs to enable your own key to work with this option.

provider.description: Speech providers supported by the app.

modelId.description: The model id of the speech gen.

voiceId.description: The voice id for the speech service.

backChannelling.description: Whether to say umm, sure, etc.. when the user is talking for too long.

enableLongMessageBackchannelling.description: Whether to say umm, sure, etc.. when the user is talking for too long.

speechGen.description: **Speech Generation**: The configuration options for the speech generation provider used by the agent.

config.description: **Call Configuration**: The call configuration settings for the agent.

light.description: Whether to enable light mode for the agent. If set to true, the agent will not retain previous chat interactions for privacy reasons.

enableVertex.description: Whether to enable Vertex AI for the agent.

autoOpenWidget.description: Whether to auto-open the widget when the agent is loaded.

createdAtUNIX.description: The timestamp when the agent was created, formatted as an ISO 8601 string. Useful for tracking tool lifecycle.

agentPlatform.description: Specifies the platform on which the agent operates, such as web, mobile, or other environments.

storageID.description: The identifier for the agent's storage configuration.

VF_ENVIRONMENT_ALIAS.description: Voiceflow environment alias for runtime calls (`versionID` / v4 session). Unset defaults to `production` so existing agents keep working.

voiceflowRuntimeMode.description: Controls which Voiceflow runtime path the agent should use.

roundedImageURL.description: URL pointing to the rounded image asset used to visually represent the agent.

rectangeImageURL.description: URL pointing to the rectangular image asset for the agent's branding or display.

scrollAnimation.description: Indicates whether scroll animations are enabled for smooth transitions in the chat interface.

proactiveMessage.description: A predefined message the agent sends proactively to engage users.

chatBgURL.description: URL of the background image used in the chat interface.

messageAggregationSeconds.description: Number of seconds the AI should wait and aggregate consecutive user messages (text + images) before triggering a single reply. Applies globally to all text-based channels (Web, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, SMS, Discord). Runtime default/floor is 5 seconds so image+follow-up text merge into one turn. Higher values further debounce; every new inbound message resets the wait timer.

lang.description: Specifies the default language for the agent's interactions and responses.

enableAudioSupport.description: Enables audio features, allowing the agent to process and respond to audio inputs.

AITranslateTo.description: Defines the target language for AI translation during interactions.

enableAITranslate.description: Activates AI-based translation for multilingual support.

disableNoReplyListener.description: Disables the listener for instances where no reply is detected from the agent.

disableHumanHandoff.description: Prevents the agent from escalating interactions to a human operator.

alwaysShowHandoff.description: Ensures the handoff option is always visible, regardless of agent status.

manualControl.description: Allows manual control over specific agent functionalities.

enableVGHandoff.description: Activates VG-specific handoff mechanisms for the agent.

enableGeoAnalytics.description: Enables geographic analytics to track user interactions based on location.

hideVoiceflowAnalytics.description: Hides Voiceflow-specific analytics including intents, conversation flow metrics, and rating analytics.

hideCallAnalytics.description: Hides voice call analytics including duration, latency, cost breakdown, call counts, and call end reasons.

hideConversationMetrics.description: Hides conversation metrics including user retention, conversation length, time retention, and engagement metrics.

hideCustomAnalytics.description: Hides user-created custom charts and metrics from the analytics dashboard.

hideVapiAnalytics.description: Hides VAPI-specific analytics including cost tracking and voice-related metrics.

hideFunnelAnalytics.description: Hides the user engagement funnel chart that tracks progression from widget views to high engagement.

hideHandoffAnalytics.description: Hides handoff analytics including accepted handover count, average response time, and average handling time metrics.

fixedHandoffPopup.description: Ensures the handoff popup remains fixed in the interface.

buttonsLayout.description: Defines the layout and style of buttons in the agent's interface.

ADVANCED_customCSS.description: Specifies advanced custom CSS for overriding the default styling of the agent's interface.

messagesLimit.description: Sets a cap on the number of messages the agent can exchange in a single session.

whatsappToken.description: Token for authenticating and integrating with WhatsApp services.

whatsappNumberId.description: The ID associated with the WhatsApp number used by the agent.

whatsappBusniessId.description: The business ID for WhatsApp integration, enabling enterprise-level features.

enabled.description: When enabled, inbound WhatsApp webhooks are forwarded to a developer-provided server and the returned payload is sent back through WhatsApp.

webhookUrl.description: Developer webhook URL that receives raw WhatsApp events and returns the outgoing WhatsApp payload to send.

forwardToDeveloper.description: When enabled, the raw Meta webhook payload is forwarded to the developer URL with zero alteration. The developer response is sent directly to the WhatsApp API as-is, with no normalization or processing.

whatsappCustomBridge.description: Developer-focused WhatsApp bridge that bypasses the built-in agent reply flow.

waTestNumber.description: A test number used during WhatsApp integration setup or testing.

waVerifyPassed.description: Indicates if WhatsApp verification was successfully completed.

waTestPassed.description: Indicates if the WhatsApp integration test was successful.

twilioSmsAccountSid.description: Twilio Account SID for SMS integration.

twilioSmsAuthToken.description: Twilio Auth Token for SMS integration (encrypted).

twilioSmsPhoneNumber.description: Twilio phone number for SMS integration.

twilioSmsMode.description: Mode for Twilio SMS - using own account or platform rental.

twilioSmsVerified.description: Indicates if the Twilio SMS integration is verified.

twilioSmsPhoneNumberSid.description: Twilio IncomingPhoneNumber SID for platform rental numbers (used for releasing).

twilioSmsRentalSubscriptionId.description: Stripe subscription ID for platform rental SMS number billing.

twilioSmsRentalStatus.description: Status of the SMS number rental subscription.

webhookUrl.description: The URL where the agent sends webhook events to external systems.

gcloudPrivateKey.description: Private key for Google Cloud services integration.

gcloudClientEmail.description: Client email for Google Cloud authentication.

smartInit.description: Activates smart initialization features for the agent.

UIhandoffTitle.description: Title displayed during UI handoff interactions.

UIhandoffSubtitle.description: Subtitle displayed during UI handoff interactions.

igVerified.description: Indicates if the agent's Instagram integration is verified.

igAccessToken.description: Access token for authenticating Instagram API requests.

showHandoffEvenIfOffline.description: Displays the handoff option even if the agent is offline.

persistHandoffOnRefresh.description: Maintains handoff state when users refresh or close their browser tabs.

enableBugReporting.description: Enables bug reporting module in the conversation's controls.

blockInputDuringHandoffRequest.description: Blocks chat input when a user requests human handoff but no human has been assigned yet. Only applies to VF agents.

disableHandoffMessages.description: When enabled, the system will not send automatic messages when handoff occurs (e.g., 'Now chatting with John').

disableHandoffStatusMessages.description: When enabled, the system will not send status messages during handoff transitions (e.g., 'We are connecting you to a human', 'Handoff cancelled', 'No agent was available').

customButtonJSON_STRING.description: JSON string defining custom buttons for the agent's interface.

structuredSearchJobIds.description: Schema-crawl job IDs indexed into Structured Search and attached to this agent.

vg_uiEngineChannelConfig.description: Per-channel toggles for UI Engine message types (choice, visual, cardV2, file, …). Missing keys = enabled.

vg_enableUIEngineForms.description: Enables form and input components in the UI engine for web channel.

vg_enableUIEngineInvoice.description: Enables the invoice card component in the UI engine for web channel.

notifyOnButtonClick.description: When true, invoice action button clicks send a notification email to notifyEmails (chat summary + invoice + contact + convo link).

notifyEmails.description: Recipients for invoice button-click notifications. Defaults to workspace emails in the UI; may be edited freely.

vg_uiEngineInvoiceConfig.description: Post-booking/payment notification config for the UI engine invoice card (shown under Enable UI Engine Invoice).

vg_enableUIEngineCalendarBooking.description: Enables the interactive calendar booking widget in the UI engine for web channel.

connectionId.description: Google Calendar connection ID used for availability + booking.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID within the connected Google account to book against.

timezoneMode.description: Whether to auto-detect the visitor timezone or always use a fixed timezone.

fixedTimezone.description: IANA timezone to use when timezoneMode is "fixed".

bufferMinutes.description: Buffer time (minutes) to leave between booked events.

daysAhead.description: How many days ahead visitors are allowed to book.

suggestedFields.description: Suggested confirmation fields (e.g. name, email) collected after a slot is picked.

vg_uiEngineCalendarConfig.description: Configuration for the UI engine calendar booking widget (connection, duration, timezone, suggested fields).

description.description: A short description of what this node does and when it should be used, specially useful if the node is global or when the LLM detects automatic rerouting.

instructions.description: What should this LLM node do.

language.description: Preferred language code for this node responses and runtime filler/tool-status phrases (ISO-639-1, e.g. 'en', 'bg', 'es').

voiceInstructions.description: The voice instructions for this node, will be used instead of instructions in voice channels if provided.

isGlobal.description: If true, this node will be always present for the LLM

toolsIds.description: The tools that will be available for this node

condition.description: The condition that will be checked to determine if the node should advanced to the selected node id or not or should simply loop in the current node.

childrenNodes.description: The outputs of this node which the node after finishing will choose from to either advance or to keep looping in this node till it caputures or reaches one of the mentioned routers.

maxTokens.description: The max tokens of the LLM

customModelId.description: The custom model id of the LLM

serverUrl.description: The server url of the LLM

apiKey.description: The api key of the LLM

maxTokens.description: The max tokens of the LLM

customModelId.description: The custom model id of the LLM

serverUrl.description: The server url of the LLM

apiKey.description: The api key of the LLM

routerLlmConfig.description: The LLM config that will be used for the router node, NOTE: This must be a fast LLM model or the latency will be too high between responses.

toolUseBias.description: The bias of the LLM to use tools if 0 it will never use tools, if 1 it will only use tools.

enabled.description: If true, the LLM will try to detect if the user has changed his mind about something enabling the AI to rewind back to the previous node.

level.description: The level of rewinding, if 1 the LLM will have access to only 1 level or rewind capabilities meaning if it went from node A > B > C > D  then if it at node d & it detects it needs to be at node B again it will be able to rewind back to node B if the level is at least 2, it will not be able to detect node A unless the level is 3 or more, and so on.

autoRerouter.description: The auto rerouter of this node.

type.description: The type of the node, if not provided it will be a normal LLM node.

rf.description: The position of the node in the reactflow canvas.

maxChunks.description: The max chunks to retrieve per generated search query.

maxQueries.description: The max number of search queries the runtime may generate when KB search is needed.

tags.description: The tags to use to filter the docs we search through

smartSearch.description: If true, the LLM will use the smart search to search through the docs.

searchOnStart.description: If true, run KB search on the conversation start trigger to prefetch context for the opening reply. Defaults to false.

condition.description: The condition to check.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to.

enabled.description: If true, we will send a GET request to the URL before starting the node.

testConvoIdValue.description: The value to test the URL with.

preStart.description: The pre start tool of the node, we will send a GET request to this URL before starting the node and provide the results to the AI. GET {url}/{user_id}/{node_name}

initialMessage.description: Fixed opening message for text channels when the AI speaks first. Empty/omitted = AI generates from the prompt.

voiceInitialMessage.description: Fixed opening message for voice channels when the AI speaks first. Falls back to initialMessage when unset. Empty/omitted = AI generates from the prompt.

initialUiMessages.description: UI Engine JSON array used as the fixed opening for text channels. Saved at design-time; no runtime generation.

userStarts.description: Whether the user or AI agent gives the first message by default for text channels (and voice when no voice override is set).

inboundUserStarts.description: Optional override for inbound voice calls. When set, this replaces the default first-speaker behavior for callers who dial the agent.

outboundUserStarts.description: Optional override for outbound voice calls. When set, this replaces the default first-speaker behavior for calls the agent places to someone else.

cacheFirstResponse.description: Deprecated. First AI reply is cached unless preStart is enabled or variables/prompt personalization apply.

items.description: A node in the LLM chain.

enableFallback.description: Enable fallback for the agent llm model.

model.description: The model to use for fallback.

fallbackSettings.description: Fallback settings for the agent llm model.

enabled.description: Whether to show the agent in marketplace or not.

priceUSD.description: The price for the agent, default is 0/free

creatorDisplayName.description: Custom display name for the creator in the marketplace

shortDescription.description: Short tagline/description shown in listing cards (max 200 chars)

documentation.description: Full markdown documentation explaining the agent

name.description: Name of the tool

description.description: Description of what the tool does

setupInstructions.description: How to set up/configure the tool

toolsDocumentation.description: Documentation for tools included with the agent

tags.description: Tags for discoverability

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp of last update

allowCanvasPreview.description: Whether to allow users to preview the agent canvas/workflow

allowTryAgent.description: Whether to allow users to try the agent widget

likeCount.description: Total number of likes for this agent

downloadCount.description: Total number of downloads/installs for this agent

disableRating.description: Whether to disable the chat end rating feature.

chatEndMessage.description: The message to show when the chat ends.

aiIntroductionMessage.description: The message to show when the user starts the chat on metachannels.

enableAIIntroductionMessage.description: Whether to enable the AI introduction message or not.

deployed.description: Whether the agent is deployed or not.

captureIGStories.description: Whether to capture instagram stories or not.

gdprCompliance.description: Whether to comply with GDPR or not.

buttonVariant.description: The variant of the button. Custom is the default original styling.

buttonColor.description: NextUI Button color token for choice/CTA/send buttons.

disableButtonAnimation.description: When true, disables NextUI button press-scale animation.

disableButtonRipple.description: When true, disables NextUI button ripple.

inputVariant.description: Chat footer input variant. Default when unset: flat.

inputColor.description: NextUI Input color. Default when unset: primary.

disableInputAnimation.description: When true, disables NextUI input focus/label animations.

density.description: Padding + text tightness for both human and bot bubbles. compact = tighter, spacious = roomier.

bubbleStyle.description: Chat bubble appearance overrides for human/bot messages.

enabled.description: Whether to show privacy disclaimer before user interaction

text.description: The privacy disclaimer text to display to users

privacyPolicyUrl.description: URL to the privacy policy page

privacyPolicyButtonLabel.description: Label for the privacy policy link button

privacyDisclaimer.description: Privacy disclaimer configuration for the agent

enabled.description: Whether to use custom lead collection rules. If false or not set, uses default behavior (collect when email, phone_number, or phone is present)

variables.description: Array of variable names that must ALL be present for this rule to match (AND condition)

description.description: Optional description of what this rule captures

rules.description: Array of rule sets. A lead is collected if it matches ANY rule set (OR condition between rules). Each rule requires ALL its variables to be present (AND condition within a rule).

leadCollectionRules.description: Custom lead collection rules. Allows defining which variable combinations should trigger lead capture. If not set, defaults to collecting leads when email, phone_number, or phone is present.

enabled.description: Whether cross-channel identity linking is enabled. Defaults to true (on) when unset.

scope.description: Identity linking scope. Default agent — only link convos within this agent.

softMatchEnabled.description: v2 scaffold: allow confirmation-gated soft matching. Disabled by default.

enabled.description: Whether email channel is enabled for this agent

provider.description: Email provider (google, outlook, zoho, or smtp)

connectionId.description: ID of the email connection from workspace

replyDelay.description: Legacy delay in seconds before replying to an email

replyDelayMinutes.description: Delay in minutes before AI replies. 0 means instant reply.

whenToReply.description: When to reply: always (all emails), keywords (containing specific words), sentiment (based on tone), manual (require approval)

replyRule.description: Hard rule written by the user describing when the AI should reply on this email connection.

humanNotifyRule.description: Hard rule written by the user describing when the AI should notify a human while still continuing the email reply.

notifyWorkspaceOwners.description: Whether human escalation notifications for this email assignment should default to workspace owners.

humanTakeoverEnabled.description: Whether AI may retake ownership of a human-owned email thread after a timeout.

humanTakeoverTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes to wait before AI retakes a human-owned thread. 0 disables automatic retake.

replyLength.description: Length of replies: short (1-2 paragraphs), medium (2-4 paragraphs), long (4+ paragraphs), auto (match incoming email)

assignedEmails.description: Array of configured email accounts with their specific settings

emailConfig.description: Email channel configuration for the agent

aiRule.description: Natural-language rule that decides whether AI should reply to the inbound message.

aiModelId.description: Model used for AI-powered inbound reply decisions.

triggerPhrases.description: Exact user-defined phrases or tags that can trigger an immediate AI reply without using the AI gate.

participantList.description: Participant identifiers that should be explicitly allowed or denied before any phrase or AI rule runs.

inboundEngagement.description: Reusable inbound engagement policy used to decide whether the AI should reply on channels like WhatsApp and email.

enabled.description: Whether auto-testing is enabled for this agent

triggerOnEdit.description: Automatically run tests after agent edits

maxTurns.description: Maximum number of conversation turns (undefined = natural end)

naturalEnd.description: Allow AI to naturally end the conversation

enabledToolIds.description: Specific tool IDs to include in tests

autoTest.description: Auto-test configuration for automatic testing after agent edits

enabled.description: Whether LangSmith tracing is enabled for this agent

apiKey.description: LangSmith API Key (Service Key recommended)

projectName.description: LangSmith project name where traces will be logged

langsmithConfig.description: LangSmith tracing configuration for this agent. If set, overrides workspace-level LangSmith settings.

condition.description: Natural language condition for LLM to evaluate

requireContactInfo.description: Whether to require email/phone before sending notification

funnelConfig.description: AI Funnel & Lead Scoring configuration for this agent

webControlConfig.description: Web-Control tool configuration (vg in-house agents on web-chat only). Controls per-action consent, opt-in eval, and screenshare permission for the visitor-facing browser-control tool family.

themeType.description: The type of theme to use for the agent

primary.description: The primary color to use for the agent

nineColorPallet.description: The nine color pallet to use for the agent

get.summary: List all campaigns for the given agent

get.description: Export chat sessions for an agent from the PG mirror. Paginated mode (omit convoIds): newest-first by default, sort=asc for oldest-first, optional fromTs/toTs unix range, cursor pagination. Or pass convoIds for specific chats. Requires a paid workspace (hasEverPaid). Paid: up to 100/page, 500 selected IDs, 1500 req/hour.
Exports a single conversation for the specified agent in a format suitable for download.

vg_enableUIEngineInvoice.description: Enables the invoice card component in the UI engine for web channel.

notifyOnButtonClick.description: When true, invoice action button clicks send a notification email to notifyEmails (chat summary + invoice + contact + convo link).

notifyEmails.description: Recipients for invoice button-click notifications. Defaults to workspace emails in the UI; may be edited freely.

vg_uiEngineInvoiceConfig.description: Post-booking/payment notification config for the UI engine invoice card (shown under Enable UI Engine Invoice).

connectionId.description: Google Calendar connection ID used for availability + booking.

timezoneMode.description: Whether to auto-detect the visitor timezone or always use a fixed timezone.

bufferMinutes.description: Buffer time (minutes) to leave between booked events.

daysAhead.description: How many days ahead visitors are allowed to book.

suggestedFields.description: Suggested confirmation fields (e.g. name, email) collected after a slot is picked.

vg_uiEngineCalendarConfig.description: Configuration for the UI engine calendar booking widget (connection, duration, timezone, suggested fields).

vg_max_messages_history.description: Maximum number of messages retained in the chat history.

ifKnowsThreshold.description: Confidence threshold for determining if the agent 'knows' an answer.

avatarImageUrl.description: URL of the avatar image representing the agent.

headerImageUrl.description: URL of the header image displayed in the chat interface.

bannerImageUrl.description: URL of the banner image used in the agent's branding.

soundEffectUrl.description: URL of the sound effect file used for agent interactions.

soundEffectEnabled.description: Enables or disables sound effects for the agent.

enableQuickFileUpload.description: Allows quick file uploads during chat interactions.

showWhatsappButtonOnWeb.description: Show little whatsapp button on web if it's connected.

disableMessageMotion.description: When true, disables framer enter/exit animation on chat messages.

showRuntimeSteps.description: When true, show thinking / tool / debug steps to end users (not only in tester).

streamSpeed.description: How fast bot text streams in the widget (1 slow … 10 fast). Applies to all turns.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether this tool is the default tool for the agent. Defaults to false if unspecified.

method.description: The HTTP method used by this tool. Acceptable values are 'GET', 'POST', 'PUT', or 'PATCH'. Defaults to 'POST' if unspecified.

id.description: A unique identifier for the tool. Ensures distinct identification within the system.

name.description: The name of the tool, providing a human-readable identifier for display purposes.

description.description: A detailed description of the tool's purpose and functionality. Helps users understand its role within the agent.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tool was created, formatted as an ISO 8601 string. Useful for tracking tool lifecycle.

disabled.description: Indicates whether the tool is currently disabled. A disabled tool cannot be used by the agent.

vapiId.description: A unique identifier for the VAPI associated with this tool. Used for integration with specific API endpoints.

isGlobal.description: If true, this tool is globally accessible to all nodes and agents. Overrides context-specific restrictions.

variablesIds.description: An array of variable IDs associated with the tool. Each ID maps to a specific variable used by the tool.

agentId.description: The unique identifier of the agent associated with this tool. Helps in linking the tool to a specific agent.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user associated with this tool. Used for user-specific configurations and access control.

backchannellingPhrases.description: An array of phrases used for backchannel communication. These phrases help in maintaining conversational flow.

analyticsRetentionDays.description: Auto-delete orphaned analytics data points after this many days (0 disables, default 90)

description.description: A short description of what this node does and when it should be used, specially useful if the node is global or when the LLM detects automatic rerouting.

instructions.description: What should this LLM node do.

language.description: Preferred language code for this node responses and runtime filler/tool-status phrases (ISO-639-1, e.g. 'en', 'bg', 'es').

voiceInstructions.description: The voice instructions for this node, will be used instead of instructions in voice channels if provided.

isGlobal.description: If true, this node will be always present for the LLM

toolsIds.description: The tools that will be available for this node

condition.description: The condition that will be checked to determine if the node should advanced to the selected node id or not or should simply loop in the current node.

childrenNodes.description: The outputs of this node which the node after finishing will choose from to either advance or to keep looping in this node till it caputures or reaches one of the mentioned routers.

maxTokens.description: The max tokens of the LLM

apiKey.description: The api key of the LLM

routerLlmConfig.description: The LLM config that will be used for the router node, NOTE: This must be a fast LLM model or the latency will be too high between responses.

toolUseBias.description: The bias of the LLM to use tools if 0 it will never use tools, if 1 it will only use tools.

enabled.description: If true, the LLM will try to detect if the user has changed his mind about something enabling the AI to rewind back to the previous node.

level.description: The level of rewinding, if 1 the LLM will have access to only 1 level or rewind capabilities meaning if it went from node A > B > C > D  then if it at node d & it detects it needs to be at node B again it will be able to rewind back to node B if the level is at least 2, it will not be able to detect node A unless the level is 3 or more, and so on.

autoRerouter.description: The auto rerouter of this node.

type.description: The type of the node, if not provided it will be a normal LLM node.

rf.description: The position of the node in the reactflow canvas.

maxChunks.description: The max chunks to retrieve per generated search query.

maxQueries.description: The max number of search queries the runtime may generate when KB search is needed.

tags.description: The tags to use to filter the docs we search through

smartSearch.description: If true, the LLM will use the smart search to search through the docs.

searchOnStart.description: If true, run KB search on the conversation start trigger to prefetch context for the opening reply. Defaults to false.

condition.description: The condition to check.

url.description: The URL to send the GET request to.

enabled.description: If true, we will send a GET request to the URL before starting the node.

testConvoIdValue.description: The value to test the URL with.

preStart.description: The pre start tool of the node, we will send a GET request to this URL before starting the node and provide the results to the AI. GET {url}/{user_id}/{node_name}

initialMessage.description: Fixed opening message for text channels when the AI speaks first. Empty/omitted = AI generates from the prompt.

voiceInitialMessage.description: Fixed opening message for voice channels when the AI speaks first. Falls back to initialMessage when unset. Empty/omitted = AI generates from the prompt.

initialUiMessages.description: UI Engine JSON array used as the fixed opening for text channels. Saved at design-time; no runtime generation.

userStarts.description: Whether the user or AI agent gives the first message by default for text channels (and voice when no voice override is set).

inboundUserStarts.description: Optional override for inbound voice calls. When set, this replaces the default first-speaker behavior for callers who dial the agent.

outboundUserStarts.description: Optional override for outbound voice calls. When set, this replaces the default first-speaker behavior for calls the agent places to someone else.

cacheFirstResponse.description: Deprecated. First AI reply is cached unless preStart is enabled or variables/prompt personalization apply.

post.summary: Send an outbound SMS from an agent's connected number
post.description: Initiate an outbound SMS using a Twilio number already connected to the agent. Supports direct sends, AI-generated opener messages, MMS media, campaign/lead metadata, and advanced Twilio delivery options.

agentId.description: Agent ID whose connected SMS number will send the message.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +15551234567.

from.description: Specific connected Twilio number to send from. Defaults to the agent's primary SMS number.

message.description: Message body for direct mode. Required unless mode is agent and initialPrompt is provided via options.

mediaUrls.description: Multiple MMS media URLs (Twilio supports up to 10).

mode.description: direct = send the message as-is. agent = run the agent first and send its generated reply.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID to attach to the outbound SMS conversation.

convoId.description: Custom conversation ID. Defaults to the normalized recipient phone number digits.

leadInfo.description: Lead metadata merged into the conversation for personalization.

dryRun.description: Validate and return the resolved send plan without sending.

createConvo.description: Create or update the SMS conversation record. Defaults to true.

persistToConvo.description: Persist outbound message metadata on the conversation. Defaults to true.

skipIfHumanHandoff.description: Skip sending when the conversation is in human-chatting handoff state.

splitLongMessages.description: Split messages longer than 1600 chars into multiple SMS segments.

sendViaEdge.description: Deliver through the edge SMS sender so transcripts and multi-segment replies stay consistent.

disableRecordHistory.description: When using agent mode, skip saving the agent turn to Firebase history.

initialPrompt.description: Prompt passed to the agent in agent mode. Defaults to a generic outbound SMS opener.

statusCallbackUrl.description: Override Twilio delivery status callback URL.

messagingServiceSid.description: Twilio Messaging Service SID (own-account mode only).

validityPeriod.description: Twilio validity period in seconds (own-account mode only).

provideFeedback.description: Request delivery feedback from Twilio (own-account mode only).

smartEncoded.description: Enable Twilio smart encoding for GSM-7/Unicode optimization.

value.description: The current assigned value of the field. This value is optional and supports any type depending on the field's context.

post.description: Creates a new scrape or crawl job for the authenticated workspace. Crawler jobs are immutable after submission. Updating a crawler job is not supported; create a new job or delete the existing job instead.

urls.description: One or more source URLs to scrape or use as crawl entry points.

crawl.description: If true, discovered URLs can be followed and scraped as part of the same job.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages the crawler is allowed to process.

urlMatchers.description: URL path matchers that define which pages are in scope.

unMatchers.description: URL path matchers that should be excluded.

stayOnDomain.description: If true, only pages on the same domain are crawled.

deep.description: If true, use deep scraping behavior.

useProxy.description: If true, the crawler uses proxy scraping and paid proxy pricing.

aiPostProcess.description: Paid-only. After each page scrape, Gemini cleans markdown (strip cookie/nav chrome, keep content/media/links).

mode.description: markdown = classic crawl; schema = AI listing→detail structured crawl.

freeForm.description: If true, AI collects page markdown without freezing a Typesense schema (markdown-only destination).

collectMarkdown.description: If true with structured crawl (freeForm=false), also store page markdown + aggregate for agent KB import alongside Structured Search.

operatorNotes.description: Notes/instructions for the AI crawler and Schema Crawl Operator chat (injected into discovery/schema/extract).

schemaCrawl.description: Options for schema listing crawl mode.

refreshRate.description: Optional refresh cadence for KB-linked scrapes.

toAgentId.description: Optional single agent destination for KB import.

toAgentIds.description: Optional list of agent destinations for KB import.

url.description: The HTTPS endpoint that should receive crawler callbacks.

events.description: Which crawler events should be delivered to your webhook. Defaults to page and final events.

secret.description: Optional secret mirrored back as the `x-convocore-crawler-secret` header.

bearerToken.description: Optional bearer token sent as the Authorization header.

headers.description: Optional additional headers to send with each webhook request.

webhook.description: Optional outbound webhook that receives `page_scraped`, `job_completed`, and `job_failed` events.
